records.text: A second former Mossad agent said Gold Apollo did not know it was working with Mossad, Hezbollah did not know it was buying from Mossad, and Mossad controlled the operation behind the scenes like a Truman Show.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #3 (Ep IqHsl7d2dos)

appearances.snippet: Gold Apollo had zero clue that they are working with the Mossad. ... When they are buying from us, they have zero clue that they are buying from the Mossad. We make like Truman Show. ... Everything is controlled by us behind the scene. In their experience, everything is normal. Everything was 100% kosher, including businessmen, marketing, engineers, showroom, everything.

verification.notes: The CBS 60 Minutes transcript records retired Mossad officer Gabriel saying Gold Apollo and Hezbollah did not know they were dealing with Mossad and comparing the controlled commercial facade to The Truman Show. This verifies the attributed statement.
